title: Lunch packed for a road that turned back
body: The lunchbox is strapped shut over a folded route map. Its pencilled approach crosses a checkpoint mark, then loops back; a paper napkin is folded into a careful collar.
rival_reading: A field crew could turn back from a restricted road and keep its meal packed; the detour could reflect ordinary access limits rather than a failed containment order.
gloss: A packed meal lies over a route that turns back at a marked checkpoint.

title: The clean circle beneath the bucket
body: Fine pale dust coats the lunchbox hinge but not its handle. The bucket below it holds damp soil and a clean round space where something small had rested.
rival_reading: Emergency crews could collect or rinse soil after a road closure; the clean space and pale dust do not establish that an agricultural program malfunctioned.
gloss: Dust on a lunchbox and soil in a bucket surround a clean, empty resting place.
